summary: First-finish smoke test of METODO LAU. Backend auth (login/me/logout, 401/403), admin CRUD (create client, update plan), client APIs (plan, logs, nutrition info + file), PDF upload/download, and exercise library (22 items) all pass. Frontend admin login lands on /admin, 'Nuovo Atleta' creates a client visible in list, client detail page opens, Salva Scheda succeeds, and the created client logs in and sees the workout dashboard with day tabs, set inputs, and Salva button.
passed: GET /api/me/plan as client -> 200 with saved plan
UI: add-client-toggle + new-client-submit creates client visible in list
UI: open-client detail page loads; save-plan-btn works
UI: created client logs in and lands on ClientDashboard with workout tab, day tab, weight/reps inputs and Salva
notes: Two 401s appeared in console on the client dashboard right after login; they resolve on retry (likely /api/me/nutrition/info before token propagation or an unauthenticated pre-fetch). Non-blocking. Nutrition tab iframe blob render and history tab UI not exercised in this pass; backend endpoints backing them are verified.
